frequency_question: How often do called indefinite strikes by major union coalitions successfully commence on or before the specified deadline without being called off or delayed past it?
membership_rule: Members include formal strike notices or resolutions by major organized labor groups where a deadline for an indefinite strike is set. Excluded are disputes that remain purely at the negotiation table without a formal strike call.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association / UFBU strike call 2012
Public Sector Bank Officers strike call 2015
Central Trade Unions general strike call 2022

provenance_note: 5 cases named, 6 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.2x)
coverage_note: 5 named major instances; believed roughly 6 total in the reference class.
known_gaps: Minor local or aborted strike calls that never reached formal execution stage are excluded by definition.
skeleton: Major union strike calls with defined short-term windows vs. instances where conciliation or last-minute settlements averted the action before the deadline.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 6 total formal strike calls recorded in major comparable banking/public sector actions.
validity_reason: Labor relations frameworks and union strike mobilization patterns remain stable over medium-term horizons.
